name: Shortcut Reference
description: A searchable shortcut reference with engraved keycaps and grouped commands, built for help panels and desktop-style web applications.

props.name: items
props.description: Grouped command labels and display key sequences with stable unique IDs. Filtering matches the rendered label, group and key strings. Display only; global shortcuts are not registered.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Accessible search label and visible prompt. Clear returns focus to this field; Escape clears a non-empty query.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
